dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: The mechanisms crafted by that Fontaine man? I placed them over there.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Me? I'm not interested in mechanisms and the like, so I haven't taken a closer look at them.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: If you're interested, though, feel free to check them out.
